ideas.title: Slow pond
ideas.critique: Already pitched in round 1, so it is judged again as the same idea; the second pitch adds the RIFE tie-in and playable wading, but it is still a place-based effect at the pond, an old stage. Time running at different speeds by place is a genuinely new law of the world, and slow-motion bodies are a strong thing to film.

ideas.title: The workshop island
ideas.critique: Same idea as round 1, now with live sandbox poses and the fetch by Lumi. It is a permanent far island plus a boat gag unless the live mirror is truly continuous. A real window into the workshop that ties each publish to something visible is new for the island and fits goal 5.

ideas.title: A friend with a real mind
ideas.critique: Thought bubbles from a local language model reading one creature's recorded day is not like any earlier post. It risks showing as text in a bubble, which is a label and not an interaction or a picture, so the payoff is hard to film.

ideas.title: Seen from the sky
ideas.critique: Same idea as round 1, with no new element beyond the HI for the human. The arrangement trick of bodies as pixels read from above is fresh, but the shape stays gather, perform, scatter.

ideas.title: Walk into a picture
ideas.critique: A painting turning into walkable depth relief on the meadow is a new kind of transformation, and the depth model is a real tool. Friends walking among the painted shapes is a mild payoff, and it reuses the gallery's pictures.
